source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Retrieve all relevant documents related to the accident, such as maps, OSHA 300 logs, sketches, incident reports, accident investigation report, witness statements, pictures (taken by your camera) and videos (taken by your video camera).
3. Write down all employee`s names involved in the accident.
4. Select the type of form you need: accident, injury, incident, fatality, discrimination etc.
5. Write down the beginning and ending dates of the investigation.
6. Enter all the relevant information about the incident date, time and place.
7. Enter the name of the company.
8. Enter the name of the victim.
9. Enter the name of the investigator.
10. Select the category of the incident. What type of injury was caused? Was it a cut, burn, bruise, fall, etc?
11. Enter a detailed description of the incident. What happened?
